verifications.claim: The Los Angeles Dodgers opened their 2026 season on Thursday, March 26, 2026, at Dodger Stadium.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The Dodgers kick off the 2026 season on Thursday, March 26." (R1); "season opener at Dodger Stadium on Thursday, March 26" (R3); "Opening Day for the Los Angeles Dodgers... at Dodger Stadium" (R5); "begin their 2026 season home at Dodger Stadium on Thursday night" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the date, day of week, and location as Dodger Stadium.

verifications.claim: The Los Angeles Dodgers defeated the Arizona Diamondbacks 8-2 in their 2026 season opener.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The Los Angeles Dodgers... beat the Arizona Diamondbacks, 8-2, in the season opener at Dodger Stadium on Thursday, March 26."
verifications.reasoning: Exact score and opponent directly stated in R3.

verifications.claim: Yoshinobu Yamamoto started the game for the Los Angeles Dodgers in their 2026 season opener.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Yoshinobu Yamamoto will start on Opening Day" (R2); "Pitcher Yoshinobu Yamamoto" and "Yoshinobu Yamamoto was credited as the winning pitcher" (R3); "P: Yoshinobu Yamamoto" (R4); "Yoshinobu Yamamoto will take the mound for the Dodgers on opening day" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly name Yamamoto as the Opening Day starter.

verifications.claim: The Los Angeles Dodgers' 2026 season opener featured a pre-game banner-raising ceremony for their 2025 World Series win.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The 2025 World Series emblem and World Series flag will be raised in centerfield" (R1); "they'll raise the banner commemorating their 2025 championship before first pitch" (R2); "The team will officially raise its 2025 World Series championship banner during Thursday's pregame ceremonies" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly describe banner/flag raising for 2025 World Series on Opening Day.

verifications.claim: The Los Angeles Dodgers won the 2025 World Series.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "back-to-back World Series champion" and "2025 World Series emblem" (R1); "2025 championship" (R2); celebrations imply win (R3); "won their Second World Series in a row" (R4); "back-to-back World Series champions" (R5); "back-to-back World Series champions" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: All sources consistently refer to Dodgers as 2025/back-to-back champions.

verifications.claim: Will Smith and Andy Pages homered in the Los Angeles Dodgers' 2026 season opener, according to USA Today.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Catcher Will Smith and centerfielder Andy Pages... with a home run"; "Will Smith hits a two-run home run"; "three-run home run hit by Andy Pages" (USA Today, R3)
verifications.reasoning: USA Today (R3) directly reports both players homered in the opener.

World Series flag will be raised" (R1); "raise the banner commemorating their 2025 championship before first pitch" (R2); "raise its 2025 World Series championship banner during Thursday's pregame ceremonies" (R6)

verifications.claim: The Los Angeles Dodgers' 2026 season opener is part of a 6-game homestand to start the season.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "at the beginning of the six-game homestand"; three-game series vs. Diamondbacks March 26-28 followed by Guardians March 30-April 1
verifications.reasoning: R1 explicitly states six-game homestand starting with opener.

verifications.claim: Dodger Stadium gates opened at 2:30 p.m. PT for the first pitch of the Los Angeles Dodgers' 2026 season opener, according to ABC7 Los Angeles.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Auto and stadium gates will open at 2:30 p.m. for Opening Day" (R1); "Stadium gates... will both open at 2:30 p.m." (ABC7, R5); "Gates to the parking lot and stadium open at 2:30 p.m." (R6)
verifications.reasoning: ABC7 (R5) and others confirm gates open at 2:30 p.m. for opener.

verifications.claim: The first pitch of the Los Angeles Dodgers' 2026 season opener was at 5:30 p.m. PT, according to ABC7 Los Angeles.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: ABC7 (R5) and multiple sources confirm exact first pitch time.

verifications.claim: The Los Angeles Dodgers' 2026 season opener was available via local broadcast/streaming, according to USA Today.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "NBC and Peacock will nationally broadcast" (R1); "TV: NBC Streaming: Peacock, Fubo" (USA Today, R3); "Streaming/TV: NBC and Peacock" (R6)
